verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs say the agent can write tests [codegen-docs-1, codegen-docs-29]. They also say it can safely run code, install dependencies and test changes in isolated sandboxes [codegen-docs-5], and that it checks test coverage during PR review [codegen-docs-20]. Together these cover generating and running tests. However, no evidence shows the agent automatically runs its own generated tests to validate changes before opening a PR; the capabilities are listed separately rather than as a documented self-validation loop. Missing for 10: a documented automatic test-then-propose workflow, detail on how test results gate PR creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
